name: Who Handles Appliance Delivery in a Kitchen Remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do kitchen renovation contractors handle appliance installation and delivery coordination?
mainEntity.text: How do kitchen renovation contractors handle appliance installation and delivery coordination?

acceptedAnswer.text: Appliance coordination is a common weak point in kitchen remodels. The contractor should confirm the exact appliance dimensions early, because cabinet sizing, utility placement, and countertop clearances all depend on those specs. If appliances arrive late or do not fit, the project can stall even when the rest of the work is complete. Ask who is responsible for ordering, receiving, and inspecting appliances. Some contractors handle installation directly, while others expect the homeowner or retailer to manage delivery. It is also important to confirm where appliances will be stored before install day and who checks for shipping damage. A good contractor will build appliance timing into the schedule and flag long-lead items before construction starts. That reduces the chance of having finished cabinets waiting for missing equipment. If you want fewer delays, finalize appliance selections early and make sure all rough-in dimensions are approved before cabinetry is ordered.
acceptedAnswer.description: A kitchen contractor may coordinate appliance timing, but the contract should state who orders, receives, stores, and installs each appliance. Delayed delivery is a common cause of schedule slips. Clear responsibility for measurements and scheduling helps prevent costly rework.
